title: Recap: *ha … volna*, and a past condition with a result today

sections.title: What you know
sections.content: You know the past conditional *ha … volna* from B1 Unit 20 and its use in C1 Unit 9. For a result in the past both clauses take *volna*: *Ha vizet tartottak volna vissza, kevesebb lett volna az aszálykár.*

sections.title: Result today
sections.content: This lesson adds a past condition with a result today. The second clause is then an ordinary present conditional, without *volna*: *Ha megőrizték volna az árterek vizét, ma nem száradna ki ennyire az Alföld.*

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: Ha megőrizték volna az árterek vizét, ma nem száradna ki ennyire az Alföld.
If they had kept the water of the floodplains, the Great Plain would not be drying out so much today.
Ha vizet tartottak volna vissza a tájban, kevesebb lett volna az aszálykár.
If they had retained water in the landscape, there would have been less drought damage.
Ha kevesebb mocsarat csapoltak volna le, ma több ivóvizünk lenne.
If they had drained fewer marshes, we would have more drinking water today.
